summary: Seabridge Gold filed a Form 6-K attaching an October 13, 2026 news release announcing a purchase agreement with Orogen Royalties Inc. to acquire a 100% interest in the Slaughterhouse Project in southern Wyoming, comprising 163 US mining claims plus geophysical, mapping and sampling data. Consideration is US$300,000 cash plus up to US$2.55 million in milestone payments; Orogen retains a 2.5% NSR on existing claims (partially buyable) and 0.5%-1% NSR in an area of mutual interest. Closing is subject to customary conditions; no board recommendation, advisor, premium or regulatory clock disclosed. Early-stage exploration asset; watch milestone triggers and royalty buy-down economics.
